people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.
translations.bsb: Anyone who rejected the law of Moses died without mercy on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
translations.kjv: He that despised Moses' law died without mercy under two or three witnesses:
translations.asv: A man that hath set at nought Moses law dieth without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses:
